reply_text:
Gist: Both pieces are dispatched and parked. I also measured what more training data buys 小象, and the backfill alone will not make it good.

**Report (what is running):**

| Work | Seat | Job | Park |
|---|---|---|---|
| Backfill, first 10 turns of 1 August | zai-2 | `invoke-1790784237152-29210-d181ae6a` | `park-dc253fe0-5622-41b3-a812-09e90d5799f6` |
| Segmenter in `xiaoxiang.py` | zai-1 | `invoke-1790784332744-29211-0ed38c5c` | `park-7222bee2-51a1-4e80-947a-29b86a488a7a` |

Both have 55-minute deadlines. All Kimi seats were busy, so both went to Zai.

**Report (state of the backfill):**
- 22 August to 26 September is done apart from 102 turns: 3,769 readings.
- 1 February to 21 August is not started: 9,307 turns, of which 2,115 fall in 1 to 21 August. I built the first block of 100 and sent its first 10 under the earlier packet rules: one record at a time, a pattern search per fragment, no generator scripts, and a mechanical check before the next chunk.
- At ten turns a job, the remaining range is about 930 jobs. I will not send chunk 2 until I have the time per record from this one.

**Report-problem (小象 never trained on the batch readings):** It reads only the live directory, 929 turns. The 3,769 batch readings were sitting unused. When I added them:

| Training set | Fragments | Accuracy | Macro F1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Live only | 3,112 | 0.30 | 0.17 |
| Live plus batches, on-list labels only | 10,514 | 0.37 | 0.22 |

**Report-problem (a third of the batch labels are off the list):** The batch readings use 634 distinct intent labels, 446 of them used once. Only 67% of fragments carry a label from the current list. `direct`, `question`, `rule`, `context` and `request` are common off-list ones. Adding them unfiltered made 小象 worse.

**Qualify (your plan to make it good through backfill):** The learning curve gains about three points of accuracy per doubling of data (0.29, 0.32, 0.34, 0.37). The remaining 9,300 turns are under two more doublings, so I would expect the low 0.40s. The model is word counts with naive Bayes, and that is the larger limit.

**Propose (order, cheapest first):**
1. Point 小象 at the batch readings as well as the live ones. That gives the 0.37 above at no cost.
2. Map the common off-list labels onto the list (`direct` to `ask-action`, `question` to `clarify`, and so on). That recovers up to 3,600 fragments without any new reading.
3. Improve the classifier within the classical constraint: position in the turn, the previous fragment's label, and a linear model in place of naive Bayes.
4. Run the backfill in parallel at a modest pace, since it also feeds the pattern graph.

**Ask-action (one decision):** For training 小象, a lighter contract with segments and intents only, and no pattern search, would be several times cheaper per turn. The full contract is what feeds the pattern graph. Which do you want for the older turns? I would use the full contract for August and the light one for February to July.
